Major<ref>{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Vakar]]|You should get back to the spaceport and give Major Brom the good news.}}</ref> '''Brom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an aide to the [[Strategic Advisor to Alderaan for the Republic Army]] and leader of the [[First Alderaan Support Division]] [[Jace Malcom]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], Brom worked with Malcom to ensure the safety and tactical superiority of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa's]] forces—a difficult task, given the Organa's inexperience in military affairs and traditional pacifism.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
